The specified pump flow, pump pressure limit, tubing temperature limit, and tubing pressure limit are all respected with the available 5 bar BPR. SCREEN, rather than EXECUTE, is appropriate because the identities, equivalents, catalyst loading, and solubility of the undisclosed base/catalyst system are absent; moreover, the coil pressure rating is not supplied and must be confirmed at or above the intended operating pressure before use.
